package personalteacher

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

// Get loads an existing PersonalTeacher without creating one.
type Get struct {
	Teachers repository.PersonalTeacher
}

// Execute returns the PersonalTeacher for studentID.
func (uc Get) Execute(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error) {
	studentID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID)
	if studentID == "" || uc.Teachers == nil {
		return domain.PersonalTeacher{}, errors.New("invalid get personal teacher request")
	}
	return uc.Teachers.GetByStudentID(ctx, studentID)
}
